prompt.alinti: I built a crew where five clods roast your LinkedIn profile and you get every roasted line rewritten.
That's because nobody tells you why a recruiter scrolled past your LinkedIn profile, so you never know what to fix.
So each clod reads your profile alone as a recruiter, a hiring manager, a founder, an expert, or a peer.
Then each one quotes the exact line that would make them skip you and scores your profile out of 10.
After the roast, it writes a new headline, a new about section, and every job on your profile. But it never invents anything.
Where a line needs a number only you know, it leaves a gap for you.

yontem.ne: LinkedIn profilini 5 Claude aracılığıyla eleştirel olarak yeniden yazma ve iyileştirme hizmeti.
yontem.alinti: Five Claudes read your profile at the same time, each one alone, as someone different: a recruiter, a hiring manager, a founder, an expert in your field and a peer. Nobody sees the others' notes.

akis.ne: Hizmetin amacını açıkladı: 'Five Claudes' LinkedIn profilini eleştirel olarak okur ve her satırı yeniden yazar.
